dispatches_reversal_shape.name: dispatches_reversal_shape
dispatches_reversal_shape.value: ("dispatches"."bags" > 0 and "dispatches"."reverses_dispatch_id" is null and "dispatches"."reason_code" is null) or ("dispatches"."bags" < 0 and "dispatches"."reverses_dispatch_id" is not null and "dispatches"."reason_code" is not null and "dispatches"."reason_code" in ('entry_mistake', 'returned', 'wrong_shop', 'short_received', 'other'))

order_events_reason_code_required.name: order_events_reason_code_required
order_events_reason_code_required.value: "order_events"."to_status" not in ('rejected', 'cancelled') or "order_events"."reason_code" is not null

orders_site_address_required.name: orders_site_address_required
orders_site_address_required.value: "orders"."deliver_to" = 'shop' or ("orders"."site_address" is not null and btrim("orders"."site_address") <> '')

stock_movements_reversal_shape.name: stock_movements_reversal_shape
stock_movements_reversal_shape.value:
case "stock_movements"."type"
        when 'return' then "stock_movements"."bags" > 0 and "stock_movements"."order_id" is not null and "stock_movements"."dispatch_id" is not null and "stock_movements"."reverses_movement_id" is null and "stock_movements"."reason_code" is not null and "stock_movements"."reason_code" in ('entry_mistake', 'returned', 'wrong_shop', 'short_received', 'other')
        when 'purchase_reversal' then "stock_movements"."bags" < 0 and "stock_movements"."reverses_movement_id" is not null and "stock_movements"."dispatch_id" is null and "stock_movements"."unit_cost_paise" is not null and "stock_movements"."reason_code" is not null and "stock_movements"."reason_code" in ('entry_mistake', 'returned', 'wrong_shop', 'short_received', 'other')
        else "stock_movements"."dispatch_id" is null and "stock_movements"."reverses_movement_id" is null end

ledger_entries_dispatch_reversal_shape.name: ledger_entries_dispatch_reversal_shape
ledger_entries_dispatch_reversal_shape.value: ("ledger_entries"."kind" = 'dispatch_reversal') = ("ledger_entries"."dispatch_id" is not null) and ("ledger_entries"."kind" <> 'dispatch_reversal' or ("ledger_entries"."amount_paise" < 0 and "ledger_entries"."order_id" is not null))

receipts_reason_code_required.name: receipts_reason_code_required
receipts_reason_code_required.value: "receipts"."status" not in ('rejected', 'reversed') or "receipts"."reason_code" is not null

receipts_online_details_cash_none.name: receipts_online_details_cash_none
receipts_online_details_cash_none.value: "receipts"."mode" = 'online' or ("receipts"."online_method" is null and "receipts"."bank_account_id" is null)

receipts_backdate_reason_required.name: receipts_backdate_reason_required
receipts_backdate_reason_required.value: "receipts"."backdate_reason_code" is not null or "receipts"."received_on" >= ("receipts"."created_at" at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 2

supplier_ledger_entries_mode_valid.name: supplier_ledger_entries_mode_valid
supplier_ledger_entries_mode_valid.value: ("supplier_ledger_entries"."kind" = 'payment') = ("supplier_ledger_entries"."mode" is not null) and ("supplier_ledger_entries"."mode" is null or "supplier_ledger_entries"."mode" in ('bank', 'cash', 'other'))
